name: persona-firsttimer-journey
note: P1 First-Timer goalpost, v2 (UAT 2026-08-09 single-panel tour + auto-jam). The old journey was 'tour -> Library -> hears a song' with a 5-tap budget to Compose sound; the tour now ENDS in the featured jam's Studio, so 'hears a song' is the tour's own payoff - sound is ONE tap away the moment the tour is over (honest unstarted embed post-reload). New tap budget: Start playing (1) -> jam on screen; back (2) -> Compose tab (3) -> one starter card (4) = compose sound in four. This scenario still owns the SAFE-DEFAULT path: the single-panel tour has NO level ask, so unset level must behave as beginner (starter cards present, nothing dense).

steps.label: fresh device: the tour greets first
ONE tap ends the tour IN A JAM: the featured backing track's Studio is open with its embed mounted - sound is a single play-tap away
level was never asked and stays unset (the safe-default path this scenario owns)
skipper lands on guitar-standard (the widest-audience default) with the tour done for good
unset level shows the beginner landing: starter cards PRESENT (the theorist scenario asserts their absence for advanced)
4th tap = compose sound: one starter fills the strip with a playable progression
and the jam surface stays calm for a first-timer - zero ambient song chrome
